description: This PHP source file defines the 'Country' controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing country localization data including listing, form handling, enabling/disabling, deleting, and fetching country information.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class for country localization management, providing CRUD operations and state management.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the country list page with filters and auxiliary data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to provide the country list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the country list HTML view with filtering, sorting, and pagination support.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing country entries.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of new or updated country information, with validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected countries after performing validation checks.

methods.name: country
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific country, including zones.
